The club plays in the [[Kategoria e Parë]], which is the second tier of football in the country. Founded in 1923, the club is one of the oldest in Albania, also being one of its most successful clubs, having won one [[Albanian Superliga]] title in 1991, four [[Albanian Cup]]s, and two [[Albanian Supercup]]s. Flamurtari is also known for their European runs in the 1980s, where they famously reached the last sixteen in the [[1987–88 UEFA Cup]], where they beat Spanish giants [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]] in [[Vlorë]] but lost on aggregate."}}
